activity.notes: Dharmapala was the second Pala ruler and is conventionally dated to approximately 770-810. Pala regnal chronology is disputed because inscriptions often give regnal years without a fixed calendar era; published reconstructions vary, so both boundaries are explicitly approximate.

sources.title: Major dynasties of north India (647-1200 CE)
sources.citation_text: INFLIBNET's historical survey gives Dharmapala's reign as 770-810 CE and describes his expansion of Pala power.
